facts.quote: The growth rate of marimo is about 5 mm (0.2 in) per year.

facts.text: V japonském jezeře Akan dorůstá až 20–30 cm.
facts.quote: In Lake Akan in Japan they grow particularly large, up to 20–30 cm (8–12 in).

facts.text: Kulovitý tvar udržují mírné vlny, které kuličky občas otočí.
facts.quote: The round shape of the marimo is maintained by gentle wave action that occasionally turns it.

facts.text: Kuličky jsou zelené dokola, takže fotosyntetizují v jakékoli poloze.
facts.quote: The balls are green all the way round which guarantees that they can photosynthesize no matter which side is turned upwards.

facts.text: Preferuje jezera s nízkou či střední biologickou aktivitou a vyšším obsahem vápníku.
facts.quote: Marimo's preferred habitat is in lakes with a low or moderate biological activity, and with moderate or high levels of calcium.

facts.text: Z jezer mizí kvůli nadbytku živin ze zemědělství a chovu ryb.
facts.quote: An excess of nutrients (due to agriculture and fish farming), along with mud deposition from human activity are thought to be the main causes for its disappearance from many lakes.
